quests.title: Quest Agents Ignition
quests.briefing_md:
# Agents Ignition

Welcome to the world of **Agentic AI**. Unlike traditional software, agents can reason, plan, and use tools to achieve goals. In this quest, you will initialize your first agentic loop.

### Your Objective
Implement a basic reasoning loop that takes a goal and returns an initial thought process.

quests.title: Quest Agents Prompts Contracts
quests.briefing_md:
# Prompts & Contracts

An agent is only as good as its instructions. You will learn to write **System Prompts** that enforce strict output contracts using JSON schema.

### Your Objective
Design a prompt that forces the LLM to return a structured list of technical tasks without conversational fluff.

quests.title: Quest Agents Tools Basics
quests.briefing_md:
# Tool Basics

Agents interact with the world through **Tools**. You will define tool signatures that allow an agent to perform "real-world" actions like searching files or running commands.

### Your Objective
Register a set of mathematical tools and verify the agent can call them with the correct arguments.

quests.title: Quest Agents Planner
quests.briefing_md:
# The Planner

Complex problems require a **Plan**. You will implement a Planning Agent that breaks down a high-level user request into a sequence of actionable steps.

### Your Objective
Build a planner that generates a valid DAG (Directed Acyclic Graph) of tasks for a multi-file refactoring job.

quests.title: Quest Agents Executor
quests.briefing_md:
# The Executor

A plan is useless without action. The **Executor** takes a task from the planner and uses available tools to fulfill it.

### Your Objective
Implement an execution loop that translates a task description into a series of tool calls and handles common tool errors.

quests.title: Quest Agents Verifier
quests.briefing_md:
# The Verifier

Trust but verify. **Self-Correction** is what separates high-quality agents from basic scripts. You will build a Verifier that audits the Executor's work.

### Your Objective
Create a verification step that runs tests against the agent's output and triggers a "retry" if the tests fail.

quests.title: Quest Agents Approvals Diffs
quests.briefing_md:
# Approvals & Diffs

Agents should be transparent. You will implement a **Human-in-the-Loop** system that presents a diff of proposed changes for user approval.

### Your Objective
Generate a clear `diff` of a file modification and wait for a boolean 'approved' signal before applying it to the disk.

quests.title: Quest Agents Memory
quests.briefing_md:
# Agent Memory

Context is everything. You will implement a **Memory Module** that allows an agent to persist important findings across multiple turns without blowing the token budget.

### Your Objective
Build a "scratchpad" system where the agent can store key facts and retrieve them when needed for future planning.

quests.title: Quest Agents Budgets
quests.briefing_md:
# Budgets & Constraints

Infinite loops cost money. You will implement **Token Budgets** and step limits to ensure your agents remain efficient and safe.

### Your Objective
Enforce a strict "Max Steps" limit and a "Token Ceiling" that causes the agent to gracefully pause and request help if exceeded.

quests.title: Quest Agents Observability
quests.briefing_md:
# Agent Observability

Debugging agents is hard. You will implement **Trace Logging** to visualize the agent's reasoning, tool use, and state transitions.

### Your Objective
Generate a structured trace log for an agent session and use it to identify why an agent made a "wrong" decision.
